title: Business Requirements Document — Requirements Chat 3

sections.title: 1. Executive Summary & Strategic Rationale
sections.body: The proposed HR Management System (HRMS) is a full-stack web and mobile application designed to centralize and automate core human resources operations. The strategic rationale for this system is to replace fragmented HR processes with a unified, API-driven platform that supports end-to-end employee lifecycle management—from recruitment and onboarding to payroll, performance evaluation, and offboarding. By implementing a robust Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) system and secure authentication protocols, the organization aims to enhance data privacy, ensure compliance with banking industry standards, and improve operational efficiency across multiple departments and branches.

sections.title: 2. Business Objectives & Success Metrics
sections.body: The primary business objectives are to achieve a production-ready, scalable HRMS that supports six distinct user roles (Super Admin, HR/Admin, Manager, Recruiter, Employee, Finance/Payroll). Success metrics include the successful implementation of automated approval workflows, 99.99% system uptime, and the ability to generate comprehensive HR analytics (headcount, attrition, payroll summaries). The system must demonstrate transaction atomicity in payroll processing and maintain audit immutability for all employee data changes, aligning with banking domain NFR benchmarks.

sections.title: 3. Scope & Operational Boundaries (In/Out of Scope)
sections.body:
**In Scope:**
- Full-stack development for Web, Android, and iOS platforms.
- Core modules: Employee master data, attendance, leave management, payroll, recruitment, performance management, and asset management.
- Security features: RBAC, JWT/session management, MFA-ready architecture, and data encryption.
- Integrations: Email/SMS/push notifications, calendar integration, and API integrations.
- Reporting: Dashboards, PDF generation, and bulk import/export (Excel/CSV).

**Out of Scope:**
- The source document does not explicitly define out-of-scope items. However, it implies that the system is focused on internal HR operations and does not mention external third-party ERP integrations beyond standard API capabilities. Specifics regarding legacy data migration strategies are not detailed in the excerpt and require stakeholder input.

sections.title: 4. Key Stakeholders & Governance Personas
sections.body:
The system is designed for six key stakeholder personas:
1. **Super Admin:** Full system configuration and master data management.
2. **HR/Admin:** Employee lifecycle management, onboarding/offboarding, and policy enforcement.
3. **Manager:** Team performance, leave approvals, and timesheet validation.
4. **Recruiter:** Applicant tracking, interview scheduling, and offer management.
5. **Employee:** Self-service portal for leave requests, payslips, and profile updates.
6. **Finance/Payroll:** Salary structures, deductions, bonuses, and tax/statutory compliance.

sections.title: 5. Business Requirements Specification Matrix
table: Implement JWT/session management, MFA-ready architecture, and role-based access for 6 user types.
Users can only access modules permitted by their role; MFA is optional but architecturally supported.
Manage onboarding, regularization, transfers, and offboarding with configurable approval chains.
Workflows trigger correct notifications and update employee status automatically upon approval.
Process salary structures, deductions, bonuses, and generate payslips with tax/statutory compliance.
Payroll calculations are atomic; errors in one record do not corrupt the batch; audit logs are immutable.
Manage job postings, candidate pipelines, interviews, and offers.
Recruiters can track candidate status through all pipeline stages; offers are generated as PDFs.
Manage goals/KPIs, appraisals, feedback, and training modules.
Managers can assign KPIs; employees can view progress; training completion is tracked.
Track attendance, shifts, rosters, and manage leave/holiday requests with WFH support.
Leave requests follow approval workflows; attendance data is accurate and exportable.
Provide dashboards for headcount, attrition, payroll summaries, and department statistics.
Dashboards load within 2 seconds; reports can be exported to Excel/CSV and PDF.
Send email/SMS/push notifications for approvals, reminders, and announcements.
Notifications are delivered within 5 minutes of trigger; templates are configurable.
Maintain immutable audit logs and activity history for all data changes.
Audit logs cannot be modified or deleted; logs include user ID, timestamp, and action details.
Configure master data, organization settings, workflows, and notification templates.
Admins can modify system settings without code changes; changes are logged in audit trails.

sections.title: 6. Assumptions & Operational Constraints
sections.body:
**Assumptions:**
- The system will be deployed in a cloud environment with high availability.
- Users have access to mobile devices (Android/iOS) and web browsers.
- Existing employee data can be migrated via bulk import (Excel/CSV).

**Operational Constraints:**
- The system must support 99.99% uptime as per banking domain NFR benchmarks.
- Data privacy and security must comply with PCI-DSS, SOX, AML/KYC, and ISO 27001 standards.
- The system must be API-driven to allow future integrations with other enterprise systems.

sections.title: 7. Risk & Compliance Baseline
sections.body:
The project must adhere to banking industry compliance frameworks:
- **PCI-DSS:** Ensure secure handling of any financial data related to payroll.
- **SOX:** Maintain audit immutability and transaction atomicity for financial records.
- **AML/KYC:** Implement robust identity verification and access controls for employee data.
- **ISO 27001:** Establish information security management systems for data encryption and backup.

Risks include potential data breaches if RBAC is not strictly enforced, and compliance violations if audit logs are not immutable. Mitigation strategies include regular security audits, penetration testing, and continuous monitoring of system logs.

File: HR Management System.pdf
--- Page 1 ---
HR Management System 
 
Build a complete HR Management System (HRMS) as a full-stack web and mobile 
application with role-based access for Super Admin, HR/Admin, Manager, Recruiter, 
Employee, and Finance/Payroll users. The system should include **secure authentication, 
role and permission management, employee master data, departments, designations, branches, 
employee onboarding/offboarding, employee profiles, document management, attendance, 
shift and roster management, leave and holiday management, work-from-home/remote-work 
requests, regularization, timesheets, payroll, salary structures, deductions, bonuses, 
reimbursements, payslips, tax/statutory information, recruitment and applicant tracking, job 
postings, candidate pipeline, interviews, offers, joining management, performance 
management, goals/KPIs, appraisals, feedback, training and learning, asset management, 
employee grievances, announcements, notifications, company policies, HR letters/certificates, 
expense management, travel requests, approval workflows, surveys, employee self-service, 
manager self-service, and comprehensive dashboards and reports. Include search, filters, 
sorting, pagination, bulk import/export, Excel/CSV upload, PDF generation, audit logs, 
activity history, configurable workflows, email/SMS/push notifications, reminders, 
calendar integration, and API integrations. The dashboard should provide HR analytics 
such as headcount, attendance, leave utilization, attrition, recruitment status, payroll 
summaries, department statistics, performance, pending approvals, and upcoming events. 
The project should have a modern responsive UI for Web, Android, and iOS, with a 
centralized backend API, relational database, file/document storage, notification service, 
background jobs, logging, monitoring, validation, encryption, backups, and strong security 
including RBAC, JWT/session management, password policies, MFA-ready architecture, 
API authorization, data privacy, audit trails, and secure document access. Define 
complete workflows such as Recruitment → Candidate Selection → Offer → Joining → 
Onboarding → Employee → Attendance/Leave → Payroll → Performance → 
Promotion/Transfer → Offboarding/Exit, with configurable approval chains for HR, 
managers, finance, and admins. Include master-data configuration, organization settings, 
financial/payroll settings, notification templates, workflow configuration, reports, audit logs, 
and system administration. The final system should be production-ready, scalable, API-
driven, well-documented, tested, and include BRD, SRS, database schema/ERD, API 
documentation, RTM, UI/UX specifications, user stories with acceptance criteria, test 
cases, deployment documentation, and complete role-wise functional requirements.
